import re, itertools
from collections import Counter

CT = "SALKMSKXZYRZEJFEOTMBRRZBRXYCXPNJIIWDRYADAIWKKKBEBUDDGNCXTUUBSJXMQVIVPVBYQEVVRBXMTEFGHRVULFEJZZUTXZIVBABSKQESEWKPKGXNVGTZHIFVWLCAQDHOKIGZZRV"
FREQ=[0.08167,0.01492,0.02782,0.04253,0.12702,0.02228,0.02015,0.06094,0.06966,0.00153,
0.00772,0.04025,0.02406,0.06749,0.07507,0.01929,0.00095,0.05987,0.06327,0.09056,
0.02758,0.00978,0.02360,0.00150,0.01974,0.00074]
LOGQ = [__import__('math').log(f) for f in FREQ]

WORDS = set()
for w in open('/home/ctfplayer/workspace/words.txt'):
    WORDS.add(w.strip().upper())
COMMON = set("""THE AND THAT HAVE FOR NOT WITH YOU THIS BUT HIS FROM THEY SAY HER SHE WILL ONE ALL
WOULD THERE THEIR WHAT OUT ABOUT WHO GET WHICH WHEN MAKE CAN LIKE TIME JUST HIM KNOW TAKE PEOPLE
INTO YEAR YOUR GOOD SOME COULD THEM SEE OTHER THAN THEN NOW LOOK ONLY COME ITS OVER ALSO BACK USE
TWO HOW OUR WORK FIRST WELL WAY EVEN NEW WANT BECAUSE ANY THESE GIVE DAY MOST US IS ARE WAS WERE BE
BEEN HAS HAD DID HAVING MAY SHOULD DIDNT DON'T CANT WON'T NEVER ALWAYS REMEMBER SEEN GUY STONE
GRANITE FROST IRON ALTAR VAULT MIDNIGHT LOCK CHECK KEY LINE COPIED MIRRORED TRIOS ONCE WRITTEN
WHAT IS NEVER ONLY""".split())

def quad_score(s):
    # use word-coverage + letter freq chi as cheap proxy
    n=len(s)
    cnt=Counter(s)
    chi=sum((cnt.get(chr(65+i),0)-FREQ[i]*n)**2/(FREQ[i]*n) for i in range(26))/n
    return chi

def chi_key_solve(ct, mode, L):
    cols=[ct[i::L] for i in range(L)]
    key=[]; tot=0.0
    for col in cols:
        cnt=Counter((ord(ch)-65)%26 for ch in col)
        n=len(col); best=(1e18,0)
        for k in range(26):
            t=0.0
            for i in range(26):
                if mode==0: p=(i-k)%26
                elif mode==1: p=(k-i)%26
                else: p=(i+k)%26
                obs=cnt.get(p,0); exp=FREQ[i]*n
                t+=(obs-exp)**2/exp
            if t<best[0]: best=(t,k)
        key.append(best[1]); tot+=best[0]
    return ''.join(chr(65+k) for k in key), tot/len(ct)

def decrypt(ct,key,mode):
    out=[]; L=len(key)
    for i,ch in enumerate(ct):
        c=ord(ch)-65; k=key[i%L]
        if mode==0: p=(c-k)%26
        elif mode==1: p=(k-c)%26
        else: p=(c+k)%26
        out.append(chr(65+p))
    return ''.join(out)

def word_cov(s):
    # fraction of letters covered by dictionary words of len>=3 found greedily
    s2=s
    total=0; covered=0
    i=0
    # simple: count letters inside any dictionary word occurrence (len>=3)
    mask=[False]*len(s)
    for L in range(12,2,-1):
        for j in range(0,len(s)-L+1):
            if s[j:j+L] in WORDS:
                for t in range(j,j+L): mask[t]=True
    cov=sum(mask)
    return cov/len(s)

def evaluate(name, s):
    cov=word_cov(s)
    chi=quad_score(s)
    return cov,chi,s

results=[]
def try_ct(name, c):
    for mode in (0,1,2):
        for L in range(1,21):
            key,sc=chi_key_solve(c,mode,L)
            pt=decrypt(c,key,mode)
            cov=word_cov(pt)
            if cov>0.30:
                results.append((cov,sc,name,mode,L,key,pt))

# ---- transposition variants ----
variants={}
variants['identity']=CT
variants['reverse']=CT[::-1]
# mirrored trios: each group of 3 reversed
tri=''.join(CT[i:i+3][::-1] for i in range(0,len(CT),3))
variants['trios_reversed']=tri
# swap ends of each trio (a b c -> c b a) same as reversed; alt: a b c -> c a b? try rotations
variants['trios_rot1']=''.join(CT[i+1:i+3]+CT[i:i+1] for i in range(0,len(CT),3))
variants['trios_rot2']=''.join(CT[i+2:i+3]+CT[i:i+2] for i in range(0,len(CT),3))
# blocks of 3 reversed whole-string grouping from end
variants['trios_rev_fromend']=''.join(CT[max(0,len(CT)-i-3):len(CT)-i][::-1] for i in range(0,len(CT),3))
# rail fence 2-5 rails, both directions
def railfence(s,rails,offset=0):
    pat=[]
    r=0; d=1
    for i in range(len(s)):
        pat.append(r); r+=d
        if r==rails-1: d=-1
        if r==0: d=1
    # encrypt: read row by row
    return ''.join(s[i] for i in sorted(range(len(s)),key=lambda i:pat[i]))
def rail_decrypt(s,rails):
    pat=[]
    r=0; d=1
    for i in range(len(s)):
        pat.append(r); r+=d
        if r==rails-1: d=-1
        if r==0: d=1
    order=sorted(range(len(s)),key=lambda i:pat[i])
    out=['']*len(s)
    for k,i in enumerate(order): out[i]=s[k]
    return ''.join(out)
for r in range(2,6):
    variants[f'rail_enc_{r}']=railfence(CT,r)
    variants[f'rail_dec_{r}']=rail_decrypt(CT,r)
# columnar transposition with short keys
def colar_enc(s,key):
    n=len(key); cols=['']*n
    # write row-wise, read column order by key alpha
    rows=[s[i:i+n] for i in range(0,len(s),n)]
    order=sorted(range(n),key=lambda k:key[k])
    out=''
    for c in order:
        for row in rows:
            if c<len(row): out+=row[c]
    return out
def colar_dec(s,key):
    n=len(key); nrows=(len(s)+n-1)//n
    order=sorted(range(n),key=lambda k:key[k])
    cols={}
    idx=0
    for c in order:
        ln=min(n,len(s)-c) if False else nrows
        # standard: fill columns in key order with column lengths
        col_len=len([r for r in range(nrows) if r*n+c<len(s)])
        cols[c]=s[idx:idx+col_len]; idx+=col_len
    out=''
    for r in range(nrows):
        for c in range(n):
            if r*n+c<len(s) and r<len(cols[c]): out+=cols[c][r]
    return out
for key in ['LOCK','SEEN','GRANITE','IRON','GUY','STONE','VAULT','MIDNIGHT','TEMPLE','REMEMBER']:
    variants[f'colar_enc_{key}']=colar_enc(CT,key)
    variants[f'colar_dec_{key}']=colar_dec(CT,key)
# every-3rd interleaves (period-3 column reads)
for off in range(3):
    variants[f'interleave3_{off}']=CT[off::3]+CT[(off+1)%3::3]+CT[(off+2)%3::3]
# reversed trios then reversed whole
variants['trios_rev_then_rev']=tri[::-1]
variants['rev_then_trios']=CT[::-1]
variants['rev_trios_rev']=''.join(CT[i:i+3][::-1] for i in range(0,len(CT),3))[::-1]

for name,c in variants.items():
    try_ct(name,c)

results.sort(reverse=True)
print("candidates with word coverage > 0.30:", len(results))
for r in results[:15]:
    cov,sc,name,mode,L,key,pt=r
    print(f"cov={cov:.2f} chi={sc:.2f} {name} mode={mode} L={L} key={key}")
    print("   ",pt)
if not results:
    print("NONE passed 0.30 coverage. Top by chi among all:")
    allr=[]
    for name,c in variants.items():
        for mode in (0,1,2):
            for L in range(1,21):
                key,sc=chi_key_solve(c,mode,L)
                pt=decrypt(c,key,mode)
                allr.append((sc,name,mode,L,key,pt,word_cov(pt)))
    allr.sort()
    for a in allr[:10]:
        print(f"chi={a[0]:.2f} {a[1]} mode={a[2]} L={a[3]} key={a[4]} cov={a[6]:.2f}")
        print("   ",a[5])
